job_posting.title: Staff Corporate Financial Analyst
job_posting.description_plain:
Apex Global Treasury Solutions is seeking a Staff Corporate Financial Analyst to lead our multi-entity budgeting, 5-year financial forecasting, and variance reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead corporate financial modeling and capital budgeting initiatives.
- Build dynamic variance dashboards using Excel VBA and PowerBI.
- Collaborate with executive leadership on GAAP compliant earnings forecasts.

Qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in corporate financial modeling and variance analysis.
- Proven expertise in Excel VBA, PowerBI, and GAAP financial standards.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, or related quantitative field.

education_status.status_stated: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

experience.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer
experience.description: Architected low-latency transaction processing APIs in Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript (React), deployed on AWS ECS with PostgreSQL.

evidence_facts.statement: 6 years full-stack Python/FastAPI, TypeScript, and AWS cloud engineering.

intended_evaluation_purpose: Transferable data engineering background applied to quantitative corporate finance.
